title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - Water
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/Water. This class is used to define a particular quantity or body of water. Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest per the SAREF4WATR ontology (imported class, not separately modeled here), restricted to saref:hasProperty allValuesFrom s4watr:WaterProperty. Own properties: hasProperty. The OWL class definition does not restrict Water to geo:Feature, but an optional location is added here as a practical addition beyond the strict OWL class definition, since a quantity of water is usually tied to a sampling point or body location.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Water'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: Geoproperty. Geojson reference to the item (optional, practical addition beyond the strict OWL class definition of Water). Maps to geo:hasGeometry in the SAREF4WATR/GeoSPARQL ontology.

hasProperty.description: Property. The water-quality/characteristic parameters measured or applicable for this quantity of water, drawn from the SAREF4WATR WaterProperty taxonomy (AcceptabilityProperty / ChemicalProperty / MicrobialProperty-BacterialProperty branches). Maps to saref:hasProperty.
